summary.text: Ethan Corson is a Democratic member of the Kansas Senate representing District 7 (Johnson County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2021.
Ethan Corson is listed as the ranking minority member of the Assessment and Taxation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ethan Corson is listed as a member of the Assessment and Taxation Committee, the Judiciary Committee and the Transportation Committee.
The Legislature lists Ethan Corson's occupation as Attorney.
The page names Jenna Brofsky as Ethan Corson's spouse.
